crossRefs.note: Moreover his mother made him a little robe, and brought it to him from year to year when she came up with her husband…

translations.web: So year by year, when she went up to Yahweh’s house, her rival provoked her. Therefore she wept, and didn’t eat.
translations.bsb: And this went on year after year. Whenever Hannah went up to the house of the LORD, her rival taunted her until she wept and would not eat.
translations.kjv: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of the LORD, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
translations.asv: And as he did so year by year, when she went up to the house of Jehovah, so she provoked her; therefore she wept, and did not eat.
